environment.mobile_scope: 390px desktop-host viewport emulation; not physical phone testing
environment.load_conditions: Local preview with concurrent workloads; not a dedicated hardware benchmark

geometry.method: meshoptimizer 1.2.0 simplify, no vertex update, no sloppy simplification, no component pruning
geometry.scope: Only ordinary rectangular BR/PL blocks; root modules, special shapes and selected-part preview retain original native geometry
geometry.error_limit_note: An approximate simplifier metric, not a Hausdorff proof or manufacturing tolerance
checks: Every retained vertex equals an original native position
Euler characteristic and boundary/nonmanifold edge counts unchanged
Top cap component count unchanged, including eight studs on the dominant 2x4 brick
Native CAD, STL, Blender, final CG, IDs, poses and support certificates unchanged
Original/lightweight toggle preserves counts, camera and assembly state

interpretation: Small input-handler/yield values do not make total rendering instantaneous. Frame values include scheduling, render submission/driver work and GPU completion. Final gl.finish calls measured zero additional wait after preceding frame processing; these are not isolated GPU profiler timings.
remaining: Measure each newly received actual case, especially the final largest case. Do not extrapolate a smoothness guarantee to all devices.
